attack_conditioned_robustness.aggregation: full response curves plus explicitly declared mixture functionals
attack_conditioned_robustness.falsifier: ranking or conclusion changes under a substantively plausible declared mixture
attack_conditioned_robustness.indicator: detector success by scheme, attack family, severity, task, language, and payload

bounded_executable_semantics.falsifier: any parse failure or unequal normalized observation
bounded_executable_semantics.indicator: parse success plus exhaustive differential execution over each task's frozen finite domain
bounded_executable_semantics.scope: declared domain and frozen runtime only

evaluation_protocol_transfer.falsifier: all admissible functionals preserve one ordering and every required component maps without changing construct
evaluation_protocol_transfer.indicator: independent replay of frozen public evaluation functionals on one common 76,032-row attack outcome matrix
evaluation_protocol_transfer.unit: one carrier-specific score under one named evaluation functional

false_positive_control.indicator: exact binomial null tail plus exact binomial uncertainty intervals
false_positive_control.scope: 24 independent fair null bits and frozen acceptance threshold

edge_policies.CodeIP: empty available prefix compares equal and is also reported under a nonempty-prefix sensitivity
edge_policies.STONE: not computed because the required perplexity-based naturalness component is absent
edge_policies.SWEET: zero-survivor rows have undefined z score and are omitted with counts reported
edge_policies.SrcMarker: deleted payload sites count as incorrect

external_protocol_replay.execution_boundary: full external embedding systems are not run because they require learned-model inference, trained checkpoints, or CUDA outside the frozen resource profile

failure_semantics: parse, runtime, extraction, and bounded-observation mismatches are retained as failures
uncertainty: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for response curves; one-sided 95% exact zero-failure upper bounds
